title: Let the search end in company, not novelty
summary: Sincere search becomes home only in guidance, company, and devotion. Do not let the search outrun shelter.
takeaway: Do not let the search outrun shelter.
lifeApplication: At the next spiritual hunger, choose one act of service or remembrance before choosing one more voice.

source.shortMeaning: Sincere search becomes home only in guidance, company, and devotion.
source.lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you.

evidence.coreClaim: Sincere search becomes home only in guidance, company, and devotion.
evidence.turn: Trade in Naam, and let patience ripen into honor.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the next spiritual hunger, choose one act of service or remembrance before choosing one more voice.
